title: Run quality gate and close out loop
summary: Completed the approved 30-slice semantic incremental transition and LLM authoring loop. Equation families use measured semantic token lifecycles, constrained LLM drafts compile to normal AnimationAssets and transition IR, and the editor exposes generated semantic equation and SVG diagram animations on the shared clock. Final typecheck, 943-unit-test, production-build, 22-test Chromium, and Theseus validation gates pass; residual risks and next focus are documented.

expectedLearning: Whether Run quality gate and close out loop can be completed inside KP Semantic Incremental Transition And LLM Authoring V0.
allowedWork: Only the approved semantic correspondence, equation compiler and renderer, representative equation migrations, constrained LLM draft compilation, minimal DiagramScene and SVG adapter, focused tests, documentation, and Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: No second clock, broad CAS, arbitrary target-math generation, LLM-authored DOM or pixels or keyframes, live model provider, general diagram layout engine, unrelated dashboard export media work, or deferred family expansion.
